title: Single-command offline Rasenfalcon preview with fail-closed candidate receipt
summary: Builds a private nine-page Rasenfalcon candidate preview using the independently owned Rasen Falcon v0.2 compiler; hashes and privacy checks are evidence of preview preparation only, not publication authority.
invariants: Website Publisher owns operator-only tools/preview_pipeline.py and browser-export qualification; the independently owned Rasen Falcon builder remains external and unchanged.
Accept only local nonsymlink candidate files and a distinct unused output directory; stage and preview privately before presenting output.
Stage report must contain nine candidate pages, CANDIDATE_UNREVIEWED, NONE authority, FALSE native_revision_verified, no CMS/Wire release receipts, exact input SHA-256.
Every built page must have noindex,nofollow; robots.txt disallows /; preview page hashes are checked against the independently owned Rasen Falcon build manifest.
Publisher preview receipt is not authenticated or signed, says deployment NOT_PERFORMED and is not a release token; public HTTPS, LDAP, RexxOS and authorised approval remain separate.
Local Python CLI is build-time operator tooling, not a Python web backend, storage provider, web service or deployment mechanism.
Publisher stays pinned to runtime-qualified NoSQLServer v0.90 until newer versions pass independent native tests.

provenance.claim: Single-command candidate-preview orchestration and output verification
19 live browser-to-builder positive and negative assertions
External owned stage and preview compiler, unchanged
